messages:
maria: anyone else seeing GPU attach failures in ap-southeast1? lots of jobs stuck after last-night maintenance :confused:
aj: yep, saw a spike ~1768004300, nodes showing nvme temp alerts then readonly mounts :warning:
sandeep: looks like scrub + fw-ops window overlapped. SMART shows temp jumping to 84-86C on nvme0 during scrub cycles
taylor: ops-bot posted alerts for 6 hosts with nvme sensor flapping :rotating_light:
ops-bot: [alert] region=ap-southeast1 metric=nvme.temp threshold=80C hosts=6 severity=high
maria: symptoms: attach hangs for ~30-60s then kube falls back. GPU scheduling delays piling up.
aj: confirmed: attach timeout at 30s then we end up requeuing pods. increasing timeout helps but doesn't fix root cause.
sandeep: short-term mitigation: pause heavy scrubs in region and reduce janitor concurrency. command I ran: ```/bin/update-janitor --region ap-southeast1 --concurrency 1 --pause-scrub true``` (ops team only)
taylor: plan proposal:
- pause scrub in ap-southeast1 (immediate)
- drain the 6 affected hosts to stop new GPU attaches (evict non-critical jobs)
- roll back last firmware push on 2 hosts for a quick A/B test
- increase attach timeout to 90s for scheduler to avoid immediate requeue
- monitor SMART + attach success rate for 2h, then decide next steps
maria: can we move some reserved GPU capacity from us-west->ap-southeast to cover customer latency? that'll cost more but keeps SLAs. estimate +4-6% infra spend for 4h.
aj: oncall can tolerate the short cost bump if it prevents backlog. I can shift some reserved nodes now.
sandeep: alternative: reduce scrub window to midnight-only and gate by temp thresholds; less cost to move capacity. longer-term we should tune thermal throttling in scrub.
taylor: I'm drafting a short runbook and will post to #incidents. assigning tasks:
- aj: migration of reserved capacity (now)
- sandeep: pause janitor + prepare fw rollback plan (ETA 15m)
- maria: coordinate with product teams for noise/SLAs
- me: orchestrate drains and attach timeout change (ETA 30m)
ops-bot: action=janitor.update status=initiated region=ap-southeast1 concurrency=1 pause_scrub=true
aj: started capacity shift, moving 12 reserved GPUs from us-west to ap-southeast1 pool. link to deploy: https://deploys/redwood/shift/1768004355
maria: noted cost impact and notified eng-leads :thumbsup:
sandeep: fw rollback queued for 2 hosts, will watch SMART and thermal logs. command used: ```fwmgr rollback --host gnode-az3-117 --to-revision 2026-03-05```
taylor: drain in progress, using graceful evict with 10m max. bumping kube attach timeout: ```kubectl patch configmap scheduler -n kube-system -p '{"data":{"attachTimeout":"90s"}}'```
ops-bot: action=patch.deploy status=ok target=scheduler-config attachTimeout=90s
aj: capacity shift done; jobs are landing on reserved nodes. attach failures dropping in the last 5m.
maria: good signal, but keep scrub paused until we confirm temps stable overnight. also log cost impact in #finance for temporary bump.
sandeep: will follow up with a postmortem: early hypothesis is scrub concurrency + slightly higher ambient temps in that AZ -> nvme thermal throttle -> controller resets -> attach race/corruption symptoms.
taylor: monitoring shows attach success rate up from 78% -> 97% after changes. keeping this thread updated. close if stable in 2h.
aj: oncall remaining for 60m, ping me if it reoccurs.
maria: thanks team. great quick coordination. :heart:
